<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.OrderTaskUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Helpers for bulk-completing open Order Tasks on a Customer Order.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>OrderTaskUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var OrderTaskUtils = Class.create();
OrderTaskUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    OPEN_TASK_EXCLUDED_STATES: '5,6',

    getOpenOrderTasks: function(orderGr) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task');
        gr.addQuery('customer_order', orderGr.getUniqueValue());
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.OPEN_TASK_EXCLUDED_STATES);
        gr.query();
        return gr;
    },

    hasMultipleOpenTasks: function(orderGr) {
        var ga = new GlideAggregate('sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task');
        ga.addQuery('customer_order', orderGr.getUniqueValue());
        ga.addQuery('active', true);
        ga.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.OPEN_TASK_EXCLUDED_STATES);
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();
        return ga.next() && parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) > 1;
    },

    completeAllOpenTasks: function(orderGr) {
        var gr = this.getOpenOrderTasks(orderGr);
        var count = 0;
        while (gr.next()) {
            gr.state = 5; // Closed complete
            gr.update();
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    },

    type: 'OrderTaskUtils'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-02 21:20:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>dad745563bc38350d5260fa693e45ab2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OrderTaskUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_dad745563bc38350d5260fa693e45ab2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 19:09:37</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
